Class Convert

public inherited sharing class Convert

Safe type conversion utility class. Provides null-safe methods for converting Object values to specific Apex types such as Decimal. Returns null instead of throwing exceptions when conversion is not possible.

Methods

public static Decimal toDecimal(Object value)

Safely converts an Object value to a Decimal. Handles null input, values that are already Decimal instances, and string-representable numeric values. Returns null instead of throwing an exception when conversion fails.

Parameters:
    value – The value to convert

Returns:
    Decimal: The converted decimal value, or null if the input is null or conversion fails
